
SASBDB entry SASDLZ6  (https://www.sasbdb.org/data/SASDLZ6/)

Publication: Azospirillum brasilense glutamate synthase hexamer, SAXS and cryo-EM (2vdc)
DOI:         https://doi.org/10.1074/jbc.M708529200

Files are SASBDB downloads (sasbdb.org/media/): experimental_data/SASDLZ6.dat, SASDLZ6_fit1.fit, SASDLZ6_fit1_model1.pdb. Nothing was modified.
Buffer (25 mM HEPES/KOH, 1 mM EDTA, 1 mM DTT, pH 7.5) and 0.15 nm: paper, Experimental
Procedures, p. 8238 (J Biol Chem 283, 8237-8249; the PDF is in sources/). The SAXS temperature
is not stated anywhere: 25 C is assumed. The .fit is an OLIGOMER mixture fit (90 % hexamer
+ 10 % monomer, paper Table 1, p. 8244); its header "Chi=   1.60" is a chi (recomputed chi
1.6012, chi2 2.5639), so refChi2 uses 1.60^2 = 2.56. The model has FAD, FMN, SF4, F3S, AKG,
OMT HETATM groups (768 heavy atoms of 89,598); the sample has no ligands.
